title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(電気電子工学科)
subtitle: Design Project III(Electrical And Electronic Engineering)
educationalGoal: Educational programs focusing on basic knowledge and skills in the fields of electrical engineering and electronics, which are highly important, develop highly creative electrical and electronics engineers who have acquired problem-finding, solving, and applied skills. This is a culmination subject following the project design subjects and specialized seminars up to the third grade.
advice: This subject is the final subject of the project design course, including an introduction to project design, and is positioned as a subject that integrates the items learned in all subjects. Aim to review basic subjects and acquire advanced expertise through experimentation and theoretical examination of project themes. They have their own project themes and work independently or in groups. Seminars are held weekly, and progress is reported using weekly reports.
requiredKnowledge: Students will be informed by the supervisor in each lab.

activityGoals.body: To clarify the purpose of the project theme and make a research plan.
To find the solutions of the problem in the project theme and execute it safely and continuously.
To analyze and evaluate the research results from the viewpoint of social needs.
To discuss in a team and to make an effective presentation on research results.
To summarize the research results as a project report

achievementLevels.ideal: The significance and purpose of the project theme are fully understood and research activities are actively promoted. The research contents and results can be explained to others in an easy-to-understand manner. The Achievement can be summarized in papers and/or be presented at academic conferences.
achievementLevels.standard: The significance and purpose of the project theme are understood, and the contents can be explained. The problems in the research can be pointed out. Application of research results in related fields can be proposed. Design and fabrication of the equipment necessary to carry out research on the project theme, can be done. Research results can be presented at the Project Design III Presentation Review and related academic societies’ meeting, and good discussion can be made in Q&A sessions. Research activities can be continued based on the research plan until the end of the project.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
